translations.web: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Yahweh, God of truth.
translations.bsb: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
translations.kjv: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.
translations.asv: Into thy hand I commend my spirit: Thou hast redeemed me, O Jehovah, thou God of truth.
